description: gte-modernbert full fine-tune (3 epochs max, lr 3e-5, bs 32, max_len 96, seed 1, early stopping on 10% held-out silver) on reused v1 deepseek-v4.1-flash labels from the v1 *seeded* prompt (20 v1 seed examples drawn from the training pool; 3,637 pool texts after dropping v2 seeds/dev uids). Served as ONNX int8 (dynamic, per-channel). Chosen on dev: label variants plain/seeded/agreement-filter x 2 seeds gave dev 0.84-0.865 (all within noise); seeded labels had the best mean (0.855). fp32 ONNX scored dev 0.86 but its CPU p95 was 57-69 ms on the shared machine, too close to the gate, so int8 (dev 0.85, p95 32 ms) was frozen.
